title: Strings & Unicode
theory:
> **Curriculum:** This chapter follows [LEARN-LANGUAGES/CURRICULUM.md](../../CURRICULUM.md). Exercise ids are shared across LEARN-* repos for cross-reference.

## Strings and formatting

`string` is UTF-16. Use **`StringBuilder`** for repeated concatenation and **`CultureInfo`** for invariant formatting.
